import ctypes

def compute_minmax(a, b):
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    gsl.gsl_max.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_max.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.gsl_min.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_min.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    max_val = gsl.gsl_max(a, b)
    min_val = gsl.gsl_min(a, b)
    return (max_val, min_val)

    assert compute_minmax(0.0, 0.0) == (0.0, 0.0)
